problems.problem: The declared direction places the disc crown 'behind the flacon's shoulders', but in the render the ember crown crosses the glass at roughly y=690-700, i.e. mid-body well below the shoulder line at ~y=435. Evidence: the orange arc emerges from behind the bottle sides at label height, not at the shoulder, so the 'buried sun' reads as a mound behind the belly and the pale juice zone loses part of its ink-night contrast frame.

The plaque band is bottom-light: title baseline block ends at y=1224 and the registration rule sits at y~1274, leaving ~166px (11.5% of canvas) of dead ink field below while the gap between disc base (y~1050) and the logo line (y=1073) is only ~23px. Evidence: in image 1 the logo nearly touches the disc edge while the lower margin dwarfs it, unbalancing the band hierarchy against the references' even optical spacing.

The 'thin hard-edge lighter orange seam line along the disc crown' is not legible in the render; the crown reads as a single flat orange edge against ink-night. Evidence: inspecting the arc in image 1 there is no distinguishable lighter seam stroke, so one declared concept device is missing and the disc silhouette carries less crafted detail than the reference campaigns' layered geometry.

changes.value: Seamless flat matte card in deep ink-night blue-charcoal, one oversized hard-edge flat burnt-ember orange half-disc centred, flat base line at seventy-three percent down the frame, crown rising to thirty percent down the frame so it passes behind the upper third of the frame, one crisp two-pixel lighter orange seam line exactly along the disc crown edge, perfectly even shadowless frontal illumination, no texture, no gradients, no objects, no furniture, no horizon
